procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/lawrence/). NOTE this county's PDF page order differs from the printed footers: the five PDF pages are table A group 1, table A tail (+TOTAL), table B group 1, table B tail (+TOTAL), then the certification page (whose own footer prints 'Page: 1', signed Nov 17) -- the manifests key every page by PDF index, not footer. Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (13/13).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets, with the pages in the shuffled order above: PDF p1+p2 = table A over the county's 13 precincts (11 columns, then West District 5/West Monticello (A-Z) + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; PDF p3+p4 = table B (same column split) carrying ONLY Circuit 14 Place 2 (its own header opens the group, no carry) and the local School Board 5 rows. The section boundary fell cleanly: no carry row. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District (Michael A. Chiaradio, Michael Guest, Erik Klehle -- the same House 3 roster four counties print, names identical); Court Of Appeals 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty -- the fifth county in the identical CoA 4 family); Chancery Court 15-Chancery District 15 Place 1 (Joseph Durr) and Place 2 (Price Henley) -- the same Chancery 15 roster Claiborne and Copiah print, names identical; Circuit Court 14-Circuit District 14 Place 1 (Mike Taylor) and Place 2 (Brendon Adams, Matt Kitchens, Albert Turnage) -- the same Circuit 14 roster Copiah prints, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 1877, Hyde-Smith 2768, Pinkins 75, Chiaradio 1745, Guest 2882, Klehle 61, McCarty 3816, Durr 3837, Henley 3808, Mike Taylor 3794, Brendon Adams 387, Kitchens 896, Turnage 3213.
operator_rows_note: All 13 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry PDF p1 (eleven precinct cells) + PDF p2 (two precinct cells + printed TOTAL); the Place 2 rows carry PDF p3 + PDF p4 cells + the p4 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the thirteen precinct headers print complete (Arm, Coopers Creek (A-Z), Courthouse A-Z, Jayess, New Hebron, Oma, S District 4, Silver Creek, Sontag, Stringer/N Pleasant Hill, Topeka, West District 5, West Monticello (A-Z) -- the sheet's own split-registration suffixes kept verbatim).
